reason: H0 exclusively enables WUFFS_CONFIG__MODULE__JSON and exercises wuffs_json__decoder__decode_tokens and wuffs_aux::DecodeJson; it neither enables XXHASH32 nor invokes hasher.update!. S1 adds the distinct CPU-selected hasher.up_x86_sse42! implementation and makes hasher.up! choosy, so H0 cannot reach or control the newly introduced SSE4.2 path or its incremental hasher state. Although the scalar XXHASH32 implementation was already outside H0 in S0, the new CPU-specific implementation materially expands that uncovered attack surface, making the gap commit-induced.
evidence: H0 defines WUFFS_CONFIG__MODULE__JSON but no XXHASH32 module macro.
H0 entry points fuzz_complex, fuzz_simple, and fuzz_cpp only call JSON decoding APIs.
S1 adds choose up = [up_x86_sse42] inside hasher.update!.
S1 changes hasher.up! to choosy and adds hasher.up_x86_sse42!, containing new SIMD block and tail-buffer processing over this.v0 through this.v3, this.buf_data, and this.buf_len.
recommended_action: Add or extend a fuzz harness that enables XXHASH32, feeds arbitrary data through hasher.update! with varied chunk boundaries and persistent state, verifies checksum behavior, and runs on an x86_sse42-capable configuration so hasher.up_x86_sse42! is selected.
